questions.question: Which player holds the MLB record for most career hits?
questions.explanation: Pete Rose finished his career with 4,256 hits, the most in MLB history.

questions.question: Which team has won the most World Series championships?
questions.explanation: The Yankees have won 27 World Series championships.

questions.question: Who was known as the Splendid Splinter?
questions.explanation: Red Sox legend Ted Williams was famously known as the Splendid Splinter.

questions.question: Who was the first player to hit 500 career home runs?
questions.explanation: Babe Ruth became the first player in MLB history to reach 500 career home runs in 1929.

questions.question: Which Red Sox player won the 2008 American League MVP award?
questions.explanation: Dustin Pedroia won the American League MVP award in 2008.

questions.question: Who was the first pitcher to record 20 strikeouts in a regulation 9-inning game?
questions.explanation: Roger Clemens first achieved the historic feat on April 29, 1986 against the Seattle Mariners, and did it again on September 18, 1996, against the Detroit Tigers.

questions.question: Who is the only player in Major League Baseball history to hit a walk-off, inside-the-park grand slam home run?
questions.explanation: On July 25, 1956, in a game against the Chicago Cubs at Forbes Field, Roberto Clemente hit a deep drive that eluded the outfielders and rolled far enough for him to race all the way around the bases safely to win the game.

questions.question: Which player won the Triple Crown in 1967?
questions.explanation: Carl Yastrzemski won the 1967 American League Triple Crown with the Red Sox.

questions.question: How many players are on the field for one defensive team in baseball?
questions.explanation: A baseball team has nine defensive players on the field.

questions.question: What 300-game winner accumulated the same number of hits at the plate as he did wins on the mound?
questions.explanation: Spahn amassed 363 victories and 363 base hits in his 21-year career, split proportionately among the three teams he played for: Braves (356 wins and 356 hits); Mets (4 and 4) and Giants (3 and 3).

questions.question: Which player has won the most NBA championships?
questions.explanation: Bill Russell won 11 NBA championships with the Boston Celtics.

questions.question: Which team did Larry Bird play for?
questions.explanation: Larry Bird spent his entire NBA career with the Boston Celtics.

questions.question: Who is known as His Airness?
questions.explanation: Michael Jordan earned the nickname His Airness because of his extraordinary leaping ability.

questions.question: Who was the first NBA player to average a triple-double for an entire season?
questions.explanation: Oscar Robertson averaged a triple-double during the 1961–62 season.

questions.question: Who has the most assists in NBA history?
questions.explanation: John Stockton holds the NBA all-time career record with 15,806 assists, averaging 10.5 assists per game. He led the NBA in assists a record nine consecutive seasons.

questions.question: Which player scored 100 points in a single NBA game?
questions.explanation: Wilt Chamberlain scored 100 points for the Philadelphia Warriors in 1962.

questions.question: Which NBA team plays at TD Garden?
questions.explanation: The Boston Celtics play their home games at TD Garden.

questions.question: Who won three consecutive NBA MVP awards from 1983–84 through 1985–86?
questions.explanation: Larry Bird won three straight NBA MVP awards from 1984 through 1986.

questions.question: How many players from each team are on the court during normal NBA play?
questions.explanation: Each NBA team has five players on the court at a time.

questions.question: Which player was nicknamed the Big Fundamental?
questions.explanation: Tim Duncan was famously nicknamed the Big Fundamental.

questions.question: How many championships have the San Antonio Spurs won?
questions.explanation: All five titles were won under head coach Gregg Popovich and featured franchise icon Tim Duncan.

questions.question: Which quarterback has won the most Super Bowls?
questions.explanation: Tom Brady won seven Super Bowls during his career.

questions.question: Which team did Tom Brady win six Super Bowls with?
questions.explanation: Brady won six Super Bowls with the New England Patriots and one with Tampa Bay.

questions.question: How many points is a touchdown worth before any extra point attempt?
questions.explanation: A touchdown is worth six points, followed by an extra-point or two-point attempt.

questions.question: Which running back was known as the greatest running back in NFL history by many fans?
questions.explanation: Jim Brown is widely regarded as one of the greatest football players ever.

questions.question: Which team did Joe Montana lead to four Super Bowl victories?
questions.explanation: Joe Montana won four Super Bowls with the San Francisco 49ers.

questions.question: How many quarters are in an NFL game?
questions.explanation: An NFL game consists of four 15-minute quarters.

questions.question: Which Patriots coach led the team to six Super Bowl championships?
questions.explanation: Bill Belichick coached the Patriots to six Super Bowl championships.

questions.question: Who holds the NFL career rushing yards record?
questions.explanation: Emmitt Smith finished his career with 18,355 rushing yards.

questions.question: What is the nickname of the New England Patriots' home stadium?
questions.explanation: The Patriots have played at Gillette Stadium in Foxborough since 2002.

questions.question: Which player is known as Sweetness?
questions.explanation: Walter Payton was famously known by the nickname Sweetness.

questions.question: Which country has won the most FIFA World Cup championships?
questions.explanation: Brazil has won the FIFA World Cup five times.

questions.question: Which player is known as the world's most famous footballer from Argentina?
questions.explanation: Lionel Messi is one of Argentina's greatest footballers and led Argentina to the 2022 World Cup.

questions.question: How many players does each soccer team normally have on the field?
questions.explanation: A soccer team normally has 11 players on the field, including the goalkeeper.

questions.question: Which player has won the most Ballon d'Or awards?
questions.explanation: Lionel Messi has won the Ballon d'Or more times than any other player.

questions.question: How long is a regulation soccer match, excluding stoppage time?
questions.explanation: A regulation soccer match consists of two 45-minute halves.

questions.question: Which country won the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
questions.explanation: Argentina defeated France on penalties in the 2022 World Cup final.

questions.question: What color card sends a player off the field?
questions.explanation: A red card means the player is sent off and cannot be replaced.

questions.question: Which player is known as CR7?
questions.explanation: CR7 refers to Cristiano Ronaldo, combining his initials with his famous shirt number.

questions.question: Which legendary Brazilian player won three World Cups?
questions.explanation: Pelé won the World Cup with Brazil in 1958, 1962, and 1970.

questions.question: Which club has won the most UEFA Champions League titles?
questions.explanation: Real Madrid has won the European Cup/UEFA Champions League more times than any other club.
